up: List all unique compounds that are reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL3638774. For each compound, provide its ChEMBL identifier (the public compound ID) and its canonical SMILES. Return each distinct compound only once.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
    cs.canonical_smiles
FROM docs d
JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3638774';
